references.text: Prohibition against turning to mediums and spiritists, also mentioned in Deuteronomy 18:11
Death penalty is prescribed for anyone who turns to mediums and spiritists
Punishment for men and women who practice mediumship or divination
Saul seeks out the woman at En-Dor who summons the dead, despite the prohibition against such practices
King Manasseh practiced mediumship and divination, which was evil in the Lord's sight
King Manasseh used mediums and spiritists and did much evil
Isaiah warns against seeking help from mediums and spiritists instead of turning to God
Paul casts out a spirit of divination from a slave girl in Philippi
Those who had practiced sorcery burned their books after becoming believers
Sorcery is listed among the deeds of the flesh that prevent inheritance in God's kingdom
Those who practice sorcery will have their portion in the lake that burns with fire and sulfur
